name: Return to Rorian
summary: Return to Rorian is a mission carrying urgent reports from the field back to Thendal Grove on Zephras Isle. After aiding Yala Windwatcher against encroaching forces, an adventurer is dispatched to inform Rorian the Dayseeker that the Al'Aketh cult has actively escalated their presence by disturbing the local wind spirits.

sections.title: A Dire Report
sections.body: Following the disruption dealt to the agitators harassing Zephras Isle, Yala Windwatcher stays behind to mop up remaining hostiles while tasking you with an essential duty: delivering intelligence. Thendal Grove needs to know that the mysterious Al'Aketh are no longer operating purely in the shadows.

sections.title: Escalation at the Standing Stones
sections.body: Upon receiving the report, Rorian the Dayseeker admits that the leaders in Thendal Grove have watched the cult's movements from a distance for some time. However, the cultists agitating the native wind spirits near the standing stones marks a bold and troubling escalation that grove leadership can no longer afford to observe passively.

faq.q: Who sends you to speak with Rorian?
faq.answer: Yala Windwatcher sends you to report to Rorian after you help suppress the hostile agitators threatening the local area.

faq.q: Where is Rorian the Dayseeker located?
faq.answer: Rorian the Dayseeker can be found in Thendal Grove, the settlement where the grove's leaders oversee affairs on Zephras Isle.

The Al'Aketh are a cult operating on Zephras Isle. While previously monitored quietly from afar, their recent actions agitating elemental wind spirits near the standing stones have turned them into an active threat.

faq.q: Why was Rorian not surprised by the news?
faq.answer: Rorian and the grove leadership were already aware of the cult's movements across the island, though they had previously chosen to watch them quietly rather than confront them directly.

faq.q: What happens after reporting back to Rorian?
faq.answer: After acknowledging your report and thanking you for aiding Thendal Grove, Rorian directs your attention toward handling the rising spiritual crisis in Aetheen of the Gales.
Yala Windwatcher chose to remain at the site of conflict to finish dealing with any lingering stragglers while sending you ahead with the urgent intelligence.

angles.text: The revelation that the Al'Aketh are deliberately agitating wind spirits strikes at the core of a Shaman's duty to maintain elemental balance.
The defense of Thendal Grove and the preservation of peaceful harmony within Zephras Isle's sacred grounds naturally aligns with Druidic vows.
